subject: Unexpected throttling during morning scale test — tenant quota mapping
messages:
From: Laura Gellar <laura.gellar@horizonhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-oncall@horizonhealth.com, kevin.cho@horizonhealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 07:42:00 -0700
Subject: Production scale test - sudden throttling and 5xx spike

Hi Neha,

We kicked off a scheduled scale test this morning (09:30 PDT) against the sandbox/dedicated endpoint you provisioned for us and saw sustained 429 spikes and intermittent 503s across multiple projects in our org. Latency jumped from 140ms p50 to >2.2s p50 and p95s were timing out. Our ingest pipeline retried aggressively which made things worse.

Attached is our telemetry snapshot and a small log snippet. We believe this started when we crossed the 3k rps mark but the behavior looks like a quota or tier mapping issue rather than capacity. Can you confirm immediately? This is affecting our integration test window.

We need:
- A short postmortem and immediate mitigation steps (rollback or temp quota bump)
- Whether this will impact our go-live next week

Thanks,
Laura
VP, Platform Engineering
Horizon Health

Attachments: horizon-429-spike-heatmap.png, support-log-sample-20260512.txt

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Gellar <laura.gellar@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production scale test - sudden throttling and 5xx spike

Laura — thank you for the heads up and the files. Sorry you're seeing this during a test. I've looped in Rishi (SRE/account lead) and Marissa (CS) to triage.

Initial steps we are taking now:
- Rishi will run a live quota mapping check for your org+projects and confirm any misapplied tiering rules.
- We'll temporarily increase the project limit for the affected projects while we isolate the root cause (expected 15–30m).
- We will pause any automated retries if that’s contributing to the retry storm — please let us know if you can toggle that client-side.

I'll update you within 20 minutes with ETA on the temporary change and a mitigation plan.

— Neha
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production scale test - sudden throttling and 5xx spike

Investigating — initial findings:
- Quick audit shows the customer org had two project-level quota entries: one patched as 'enterprise-tier' and another legacy entry pinned at a much lower per-project limit. The routing layer is honoring the lower project-level limit for the projects under test due to a stale precedence rule.
- This mismatch can produce 429s exactly like Laura reported once aggregate requests exceed the lower project cap; retries then amplify the observed 5xx/timeout cascade.

Planned immediate mitigation:
1) Override precedence for the affected projects to prefer org-level enterprise-tier for 30 minutes (rollbackable) — estimated time: 10–12 minutes.
2) Temporarily enable linear backoff in the gateway for that org to reduce retry amplification (30 min window).
3) Collect sampling traces and push a quota-mapping audit CSV for Horizon for postmortem.

I’m on the change now and will post the rollback ID and results.

— Rishi
Principal SRE

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:22:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production scale test - sudden throttling and 5xx spike

Change applied: override precedence for org HLN-2026-045 -> per-project limits now inherit enterprise-tier.
Change ID: CHG-20260512-8791
Rollout: immediate, target projects (horizon-prod-infer-1, horizon-prod-infer-2).
Observed after 4 minutes: 429 rate dropped ~92% for the affected projects; p95 latency returned to ~280–350ms.
Sampling logs uploaded: support-log-sample-20260512.txt; audit export: quota-mapping-audit.csv.

Notes: We saw the legacy lower cap originate from a historical sandbox import that kept a high-priority project entry. I will open a follow-up to remove the stale precedence rule and create a validation check in the next config deploy.

— Aditya
Senior Infra Engineer, Runtime

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Gellar <laura.gellar@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production scale test - sudden throttling and 5xx spike

Laura — short update: we identified a quota precedence mismatch and pushed a temporary override. Our telemetry shows a ~90% reduction in 429s within the first 4 minutes and p95 latency dropped significantly. Aditya attached the logs and the audit CSV for your review.

Action items we will follow up on within 48 hours:
- Permanent remediation to remove stale project precedence rules (Aditya, Rishi)
- Add a pre-deploy validation that flags conflicting per-project entries for orgs with enterprise-tier (Rishi)
- Mitigation playbook: short-term quota bump and gateway backoff toggles (Marissa)

If you’d like a temporary quota bump for the full stress window rather than the override, we can do that — let me know and I’ll coordinate procurement approvals.

Thanks for flagging this quickly. We’ll prepare a concise incident summary for your team.

Best,
Neha

From: Laura Gellar <laura.gellar@horizonhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-oncall@horizonhealth.com, kevin.cho@horizonhealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production scale test - sudden throttling and 5xx spike

Thanks Neha, Rishi, Aditya — appreciate the fast turnaround and the temporary fix. The test resumed at ~08:40 and finished cleanly. A couple of asks before we close this:

1) Please share the postmortem and the quota-mapping CSV (we need it for our compliance team).
2) Do you recommend we keep retries disabled client-side for the next 24 hours while you finish the validation change?
3) We may request a one-time quota bump for the go-live; please outline the procurement steps and lead time.

If you can get the postmortem and links into the HubSpot record HLN-2026-045 that would be great.

— Laura
